steps.name: Fragment of Memory (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Adkina] in the “Valley of the Dragon”, obtain <Fragments of Memory> from the monsters in the “Valley of the Dragon”. And report to [Adkina].

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Thanks for coming. I don't know if I'm keeping you busy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. I think I know a little bit about what you're talking about... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Is that so? You already know. About the expression on your face that has lost your memory... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It is said that he received help from Shinik due to his memory-less expression.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Even though the child grumbles, he gives everything to the person he considers his.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Anyway. Don't doubt it. I was going to talk about tears of light too. If you boil it and drink it, there are almost no side effects.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, it wasn't just swallowing.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Did you swallow it? That poisonous thing... ?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: (Adkina looks sad.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Do you remember what I gave for Him before?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A fragment of memory?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yes, the 'fragments of memories' back then were entirely for him, but what I'm talking about this time may be for your memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina, I don’t remember losing anything in the Land of Illusion… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Think of it as acting like tears of light. Do you really think I'm going to feed them something dangerous this time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, isn't that it?!

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I will create it and deliver it with my power, so don’t be too scared. It would be nice if we could get some from the phantom beast in the Valley of the Dragon.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Then I will purify it and infuse you with energy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Adkina! Then I'll be back!

steps.name: Fragment of Memory (2)
steps.objective: Complete the quest in front of the [Xenadia Statue] in “Orca Beach.”

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Good job! Then let the purification begin.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Okay, that's it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eh, already?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It won't take a long time. I hope I can be of help to you, even if my skills are lacking.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: That energy has already been directed to you, so if there is a chance, the memories will come back in no time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Adkina! Oh, but it looks like you have something to say.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You are quick-witted. There's a story I'd like you to hear. Do you know anything about Zenadia?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I've been there before... . I don't really remember what happened there.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Perhaps you have lost your memories of Zenadia. Why did I talk about Zenadia... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: That is my hometown. All Pluton dragons were born there.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You may already know this because you have talked to me personally, but in the past, I participated in the battle to subdue the Demon King by helping Goddess Ceres.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Even though things didn't go as planned, I ended up here and couldn't return to my hometown for a long time. As time passed, Iris, I learned that the demon king had disappeared due to the goddess's activities.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Thanks to this, I also learned that the wall that separated Freios and Gendia had disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then you can visit Zenadia.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I have a mission to protect this land. Given by Goddess Gaia... . Even if the goddess allows it, I cannot leave.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: That's because there's no one to replace him. Should I also create a successor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What about Mir?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Hahaha, you're good at joking. Please come to Zenadia for me, who cannot be away, and for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Xenadia….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What memories did I lose in Zenadia?)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: What are you thinking?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. Then I will go to Zenadia. What can I do?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's not difficult. Go to Zenadia and convey my greetings to the priests and sisters. Then they will talk about it themselves.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Mir often told me my story. This time you will do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Mir is busy at Mir University, so I will come by for a moment.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Thank you. There's something I'd like to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please speak.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Is there still a stone tower inside Orca Beach that can take you to Zenadia?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, there is. You can go there if you go there.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Then, when you get there, pray for Goddess Ceres. That's my request. That's it. And once that's done, it goes back to its original position.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Then I'll come back.

steps.name: Fragments of Memory (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Priest Kratos] in the “Zenadia Ground Garden Healing Room”.

lines.text: (Warm sunlight is shining on Orca Beach.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This place is still mysterious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, let’s pray and go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I bow my head in front of the stone pagoda and quietly pray. As always, I hope that nothing bad happens to this world and Iris...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I suddenly feel strange.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it? Is it because of my mood?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 잔영
lines.text: (You can faintly see someone's remnant in front of the stone pagoda. The girl's neat appearance and wearing a flower crown gives a sacred feeling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it? Is it welcome? Who is it?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 잔영
lines.text: (The girl who appears to be a remnant smiles softly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is it? Could it be the goddess Ceres?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly the name Ceres pops into my head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right, there's no way I wouldn't recognize Goddess Ceres. Then who is this… ?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 잔영
lines.text: (The girl shows a sad smile as %s talks to herself. Then she starts to say something. However, her voice is not heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you saying, but I can't hear you? Wait, can you speak slowly? So that you can at least see the shape of the mouth.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 잔영
lines.text: (The girl nods her head and slowly opens her mouth as requested by %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Finally, my… this. The day has come... uh... . I am for you... Oh, I've been waiting for so long... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait this means… ? What is this déjà vu?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goddess Ceres? Are you really Goddess Ceres? I understand that the goddess's power has already been transferred to Iris... .

lines.speaker: 누군가의 잔영
lines.text: (The girl continues her next words with a smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello... . Wait. Wait. Uh. Until here. Oh no. It was hard, right? Was it hard for me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it wasn't difficult. I came all this way... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, various memories begin to appear in %s’s mind. Subtle emotions whose true nature is unknown….)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 잔영
lines.text: (The girl reaches out with a sad expression and tries to stroke %s's head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you comforting me?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 잔영
lines.text: (The girl gently nods her head. Then she opens her mouth and seems to start talking again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My name is. Ser.re.s. Oh.r.ka. The first stars poured down on the beach. times. Bringing the seeds of life and song to the world. Sprinkled… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goddess… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, just a moment. What, what?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Remember. Because I'm losing it. Sorry? Now, wait… . Are you saying the reason I lost my memory is because of the goddess Ceres?

lines.speaker: 세레스의 잔영
lines.text: (The image of the girl who identified herself as Ceres gradually fades and becomes less visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I was trying to say something before disappearing... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My mind is complicated. Something happened to me too... ? Why do I remember... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, if you're listening, would you please tell me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As expected, there is no answer. I can't help it. Let's talk about it later... . The reason I came here was to ask Adkina a favor first... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, I have to go to the priest I met before. That's the only thing I remember about Zenadia right now.

steps.name: Fragments of Memory (4)
steps.objective: Go to [Priest Simurgh] in the “Zenadia Ground Garden Meditation Room”.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Hey, didn't you come to Zenadia a while ago?  By any chance, is something going on?

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: I lost my memory again... . Ah, it's normal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm late in saying hello because I have something to think about for a moment. It's not like I lost my memory.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: What's happening today? Did you come to dig up potatoes and sweet potatoes for Mir like last time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's not it, I came here at Adkina's request. He asked me to say hello... .

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Senior, you are doing well. But how do you know your senior?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Priest Kratos about what happened in Adrica, the Land of Illusion.)

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Ah, it looks like Goddess Gaia has woken up. I can't believe it's already that time... . I thought I would never hear this news in my lifetime.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: But if I tell you about my senior, what are the priests and sisters going to do? I've never heard of it... .

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Wait, sisters? It seems you misunderstood something.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Mir visits often, but you don't know what happened in Freios because he doesn't talk about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So who is this sister here... ? Sister Sistine is here... .

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Currently, there are no sisters in Zenadia. I don't know what you're talking about.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: The sisters went to the temple in Freios after receiving an oracle, but then went missing.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: The news was cut off when the Demon Lord Lux rescued the children who were there during an attack on the temple.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Now that I think about it, you… .

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: It was something like that. Now I understand. You didn't just lose your memory. Should we say that we are standing at the distorted border of time and space?

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: A kind of crack.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Oh, by any chance, did you see or feel anything else when you came here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw the remnants of Ceres in the stone statue at Orca Beach.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Ah, goddess… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is that?

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: As I said last time, Zenadia's perception of the flow of time and space is different from other places.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Perhaps the remnants of the goddess appearing in front of you were meant to tell you something? First of all, it's clear that you're worried... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do I have to experience this only in Zenadia? It's not like something big will happen like this, right?

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: I'm not sure about that. This is all I can help you with.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Phew. Then go to Simurgh in the room of meditation and talk about Adkina. Then I will tell you what to do for Adkina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: I'm sorry. However, you will soon be able to figure out the cause.

steps.name: Fragment of Memory (5)
steps.objective: Collect <Purification Grass> and <Moon Halo Grass> in “Zenadia Ground Garden Central Area”. Then report to [Adkina] in “Dragon Valley”.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: Mortal, welcome. I had the feeling that a special star was coming here, and it was you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to say hello to Adkina from Adrica in Eastland.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Priest Simurgh about what happened in Adrica, the Land of Illusion.)

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: Goddess Gaia has awakened. Even though it's crazy with a lot going on, I'm thankful that I made it this far.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: When I see you later, I want you to tell me that we are doing well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: Oh, look at my mind. There was something I wanted to give to my senior... . Originally, I was going to bring it to Mir.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: However, it was a bit late as the child was in a hurry to do Iris's work... .

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: He wanted to make plants that only grow in Zenadia grow in Adrica, so he collected a lot of them... .

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: But a problem arose... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's the problem?

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: I forgot so much that I had collected it and lost track of where I put it.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: … How forgetful is this guy?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I understand what you mean. You're asking me to find it for you.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: When are you looking for that again? It would be faster to just go and collect it.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: Please pull out the purification grass and the moon halo grass and bring them to Adkina. That grass will help purify the pollution in the place where Adkina lives.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is it?

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: It's hiding in the central area of the ground garden. It will look good to you, a mortal, so pick it out and give it to your senior.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Well then, goodbye.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: And I hope I can regain my lost memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I thought I was going to go do some other business right away in Zenadia, but what happened in the Valley of the Dragon? ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I brought the plant the priests told me to bring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Give the collected purification grass and moon halo grass to Adkina.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's been a while. This is the smell of my hometown, Genadia... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I received an unexpected gift. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: (Adkina seems lost in sentiment for a moment and cannot continue speaking.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard that Mir was originally going to bring it to me. But suddenly, I felt like I was put off a bit because I had to work on Iris... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I brought it for you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Ah, that child… . He's a kid with a beautiful heart. I'll have to thank you later. Of course, you have to prepare something to eat.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: (A dark shadow falls on Adkina's face. He seems to be burdened with preparing food. After a while, his expression returns.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The thought of growing these plants makes me feel good. These plants grown on sacred land will reduce the pollution of this land.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Goddess Gaia will be happy too.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I am indebted to you again this time. How should I repay... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: But looking at your expression, I guess something happened in Zenadia. What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. That's it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Adkina what happened at Orca Beach.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Girl, what did you say? You saw the remnant of Goddess Ceres?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Goddess Ceres transferred all her remaining power to Iris. Iris Goddess Ceres cannot be seen in any form without her will.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Still, there must be a definite ‘reason’ for appearing in front of you as a remnant.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It seems that the reason is connected to your ‘memory’. Anyway, it's nice to see that your expression has improved.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Iris Everything will be resolved only if the Goddess becomes a complete star goddess. Now the goddess is still working hard... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I'll have to wait for now. If you wait, the answer may come from somewhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go then, Adkina. And I hope that the land of welcome becomes more beautiful.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Thank you. Let us create a land that will please Goddess Gaia.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: If you look at the fact that he has already passed through this difficult Valley of the Dragon with ease, he is indeed an amazing person.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Iris Goddess, I think he's hiding something. What is it? .
